Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for in-app assistant + semantic search. Started on Hosted API POC; results promising for latency but unit cost at scale is concern so they are evaluating Dedicated (VPC) for both cost predictability and data residency/security.

Key quotes / paraphrases:
- "If we can get predictable monthly spend + SOC2-compliant VPC, we can commit to a 12‑month reserved pool." — Head of Platform
- "Need audit logs and retention controls exposed to our SIEM (Splunk)." — Security engineer

POC notes:
- Hosted POC: embeddings integrated into 3 endpoints, avg embed latency 40–60ms, 95th percentile ~120ms under test load.
- Pain: token cost per session spikes for long context summaries; exploring prefix caching + quantized model variants.

Security ask (Dedicated/VPC):
- SOC2 Type II report or in-progress timeline; evidence for control areas (encryption, access reviews).
- SSO/SAML integration pattern + SAML metadata exchange.
- Audit logs: must include per-request model + route, consumer id, timestamp, and token usage; retention configurable to 3–7 years.
- KMS options: bring-your-own-key (AWS KMS) is preferred.
- Network: VPC peering + egress restrictions; optional on-prem connector later in roadmap.

Commercials / procurement:
- Expecting pricing ask: dedicated reserved pool cost + overage model; want examples of similar mid-market commitments.
- Budget holder: Director of Product (procurement TBD).
